counterfactual_missing_items: Large, slow scotopic and photopic responses
response.rationale: R4 best integrates the rod-cone dystrophy phenotype: childhood night blindness, flat rod ERG, progressive amplitude loss, inferonasal scotoma, hyperfluorescent ring, and superotemporal photoreceptor/RPE loss. R1 lacks the ERG and symptom anchors; R2 is nonspecific; R3 is contradicted by rod-predominant disease and normal color vision.

rejected.why: Shares outer retinal/RPE loss and yellow spots but omits night blindness and flat rod ERG; choroideremia does not account for the hyperfluorescent ring or large/slow ERG pattern.
Only nonspecific yellow spots and hypofluorescence; misses night blindness, flat rod ERG, inferonasal scotoma, and OCT outer retinal loss.
Cone-rod dystrophy is contradicted by childhood night blindness, flat rod ERG, normal color vision, and preserved central macula; the large/slow ERG is more compatible with atypical RP/ESCS.
